faqs.question: Does 🌦️😎 work in family groups?
faqs.answer: In family groups 🌦️😎 works best when the family already uses sarcasm as love-coded banter. Otherwise it tends to misread.

faqs.question: Is 🌦️😎 appropriate for a first date?
faqs.answer: 🌦️😎 can be appropriate for a first date if the vibe is already witty. Sending it cold can read as condescending rather than charming.

faqs.question: Does 🌦️😎 have a TikTok meaning?
faqs.answer: On TikTok 🌦️😎 shows up in comment threads as a snark-coded reaction. The sarcasm register is the same as on iMessage, just amplified by the audience.

faqs.question: Is 🌦️😎 ever sincere?
faqs.answer: Rarely. The sarcasm-coded register is the whole point of the combo. For a sincere moment, swap to a single emoji or write a sentence.
